text:
alex: Heads up — console alerted about a weird jump in per-key rateband for org-scoped API keys when requests were routed to Dedicated last night.

morgan: :eyes: I noticed the dashboard blip too. Spike at ~18:32 UTC, lots of 429-ish traces. Backend logs show fallback routing to the lower-tier pool.

janet: Were these keys part of the quota fanout rollout? I thought org-scoped keys with `org:beta` were excluded.

sudha: We rolled fanout_v2 to 20% last week. Canary had an exclusion for `org:beta`, but the routing predicate had a fall-through when key metadata was stale.

alex: That matches the console — many tokens appeared project-less and got classified as default, which triggers fanout.

morgan: Example sanitized log:
```
2025-06-01T18:32:11Z INFO route=decide key=key_ABC123 meta={project: null, org: null} policy=fanout_v2 -> pool=dedicated-low-tier fallback=true
```

sudha: Confirmed. The metadata-cache TTL renewal failed for ~2k keys during the window. We pushed a fix to extend the TTL and add defensive null-checks, but need to decide whether to rollback the predicate or hotfix the cache.

janet: Console UX ask: we show per-key rateband now but we don't indicate if a request hit fanout vs routed due to capacity. Adding a compact routing flag in the request timeline would make SRE/support triage much faster.

alex: Strong +1. Short-term: can we create an alert that fires when per-key token usage spikes AND traces contain fallback=true? That would reduce manual hunting.

morgan: I can add a Grafana panel to surface fallback=true traces and annotate ranges. For the alert, prefer ephemeral (pager in business hours, slack otherwise) while we stabilize.

sudha: Ephemeral alert sounds right. We'll also emit a permanent metric `routing.fanout_fallback.rate_by_key` once things are quiet.

janet: Also, the per-key charts are noisy because the outliers (keys missing metadata) dominate. Can we auto-group keys missing org/project into an "unattributed" bucket so overall trends are readable?

alex: Yes — an aggregation bucket for missing metadata. And a UI toggle to expand that bucket to inspect individual keys.

deploy-bot: deploy-service: canary/deployment/263 succeeded at 1754330300 — patch includes metadata-cache TTL bump and defensive checks in routing predicate, plus extra logging for fallback reasons.

sudha: Patch is live in canary; monitoring for 20 minutes before promoting. I'll follow up with a PR to add the routing flag to the timeline and emit the new metric.

morgan: Metrics are trending back to baseline in canary. I'll prepare the Grafana annotation and the ephemeral alert rule and share the runbook snippet.

janet: Filing a small console ticket: add "unattributed" aggregation for missing metadata and a timeline toggle for routing flags. Also include a note linking to the runbook entry.

alex: Postmortem action: add a simulation test for metadata-cache TTL expiry in the harness (ferris wheel item) so we catch silent TTL failures in future. Good catch, team. :thumbsup:
